serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone’s calling me…
You: Who is it?
Lady Annalie: Just look at your phone’s screen, you dummy! It’s me! Annalie!
Lady Annalie: I swear, sometimes you act like such a boomer.
You: Just tell me what you want already, or did you call just to make fun of me?
Lady Annalie: If I wanted to do that, I would come in person to see the reaction on your goofy face! 
Lady Annalie: I’m calling because my friends cancelled our plans last minute, and now I’m stuck with a reservation in a restaurant for brunch, and it would suck to sit at a big table alone.
You: I’m surprised. You have other friends?
Lady Annalie: Really? That’s the first thing you ask? Are you perhaps jealous?
You: Nah. They left you hanging, so, you know…
Lady Annalie: You really know how to get under my skin…{{wi}} PASS THE PHONE TO YOUR GIRL, I’M DONE TALKING TO YOU!{{punch}}
You: Jesus…
My ear almost broke… I need to lower the volume, just in case of another outburst.
You: Calm down, ok? 
You: We should be available. 
Lady Annalie: Great! I will send you the date later!
Lady Annalie: So it will be the four of us again! I can’t believe we became such a tight group!
You: The four of us?
Don’t tell me… {{wi}}Did she invite Melissa too? And she agreed?!
What is she thinking? Unlike {f_botName} she’s unable to eat. This might be bad…
Lady Annalie: Of course I invited Melissa too! What, you have something against her?
You: N-No, not really.
Lady Annalie: Alright! See you later then!
You: Sure…
